# archive_sha256 is the digest published in the upstream release SHA256SUMS and
# is checked immediately after download.
#
# binary_sha256 is the digest of the extracted executable. It is the value
# Hindsight verifies on a VPS before every single run, so it is pinned here in
# git rather than computed at build time.
